name: Bottled Lightning
text: Affinity: Spades. When this card wins a trick, if you've already won four or more tricks this round, gain +1× contract multiplier.

signature.trigger: this card wins, you've won 4+ other tricks

archetypes: Spade Master, While Held; splash High Card
decision: Every trick, whether to cash the spade now or hold it until four other wins are in, risking a forced play or a higher trump.
opponent: Visible when it pays; opponents who read it can void the ace's suit early or lead it to force the ace out.
aiNote: Win with other cards first; play this card only once you have four wins, or when it would otherwise be trumped or forced.
rationale: A random spade is a likely late winner, as a trump once you are void or as a high spade, so the real test is holding it until four other wins are in, met in about a third of a strong seat's rounds (about +40 late), top of the uncommon band at 80 gold; it checks your wins, not the trick number, so it stays apart from Ripening Pear (GR-C10) and Patient Hourglass (DU-S10).
deviation: Affinity changed from Ace to Spade, so the engraved card varies from hand to hand while still winning late often enough to fire.
